bodyText:
Bundle rationale
All five findings come from one 2026-07-26 device-QA session on the staging German build, all on the (auth) sign-in surface, and all verified against code the same day (root causes pinned for the three confirmed items; two are verify-first). One polish pass — realistically one PR plus a single small-device verification session — closes the whole set; shipping them separately would repeat the same device setup five times.
Strategy
Implement the three confirmed fixes first: Clerk error-code→i18n mapping with generic localized fallback (clerk-error.ts + auth.errors.* keys, 7 locales), forgot-password email prefill (mirror the existing sign-up emailParam pattern), and a submit-button keyboard anchor replacing the hardcoded fieldY-140 offset. Then run ONE verification session on an S10e-class Android profile (German locale) that (a) proves the three fixes on device and (b) resolves the two verify-first items — password masking default and status-bar squeeze — each ending either fixed or closed Not Reproducible with device evidence.
Scope
In scope: apps/mobile/src/app/(auth)/ (sign-in.tsx, sign-up.tsx, forgot-password.tsx, _layout.tsx), apps/mobile/src/lib/clerk-error.ts, components/common/PasswordInput.tsx, hooks/use-keyboard-scroll.ts, i18n auth.* keys across the 7 UI locales (en, de, es, ja, nb, pl, pt). Conditionally in: welcome.tsx if the safe-area repro lands there instead of sign-in. Explicitly OUT: auth flows beyond the (auth) group, Clerk configuration/backend changes, and any V2-shell navigation work.
Findings
Acceptance Criteria
Absorbed AC
WI-2768 — ROOT CAUSE (verified 2026-07-26): apps/mobile/src/lib/clerk-error.ts:6-12 extractClerkError() returns clerkErrors[0].longMessage/message verbatim — no code-to-i18n mapping exists; consumed at sign-in.tsx:768,870,897-901,956-957,1001, sign-up.tsx:117, forgot-password.tsx:131,192,250. The ClerkError type does not even expose .code. 1. Map Clerk error CODES (not message strings) to i18n keys (natural home: auth.errors.<code> in en.json + the 6 other locales); known sign-in/sign-up/reset codes render localized copy in all 7 UI locales. 2. Unknown codes render a generic localized message, never the raw English string. 3. Regression test covers the incorrect-password path in a non-English locale. 4. i18n orphan-key and JSX-literal ratchets stay green.
WI-2769 — ROOT CAUSE (verified 2026-07-26, hypothesis): sign-in.tsx has KeyboardAvoidingView(padding)+ScrollView with use-keyboard-scroll.ts, but the hook only anchors the email/password fields and scrolls to fieldY-140 (a hardcoded offset calibrated once); the submit button has no layout anchor, so on some device/keyboard-height combos it still lands under the keyboard. 1. With the keyboard open on a small-screen Android profile (S10e-class), the submit button remains visible/reachable — anchor the button (or field-bottom + button-height) instead of relying on the magic offset. 2. Verified on the small-screen device/emulator profile with the German locale's taller button text. 3. No regression on normal-height devices.
WI-2770 — VERIFICATION FINDING (2026-07-26): PasswordInput.tsx:32 defaults to masked (visible=false, secureTextEntry={!visible}); all three auth screens use the shared component; no unmasked-by-default path found in code. The QA screenshot most plausibly shows the toggled state or an Android keyboard/password-manager overlay. 1. Re-verify on device: fresh sign-in screen, password field state before any toggle tap; document the confirmed default on this item. 2. If a repro is found (e.g. autofill/GBoard overlay interaction with autoComplete/textContentType), fix to masked-by-default and add a regression step; otherwise close as Not Reproducible with the device evidence.
WI-2771 — ROOT CAUSE (verified 2026-07-26): sign-in.tsx:1462 pushes /(auth)/forgot-password with no params, and forgot-password.tsx:78 seeds useState('') without reading useLocalSearchParams — the sign-up link (sign-in.tsx:1532-1539) already forwards the email param, so the codebase pattern exists. 1. Starting password reset from sign-in with a filled email field prefills that email in the reset step (still editable), mirroring the existing sign-up emailParam pattern. 2. Works with partial/unvalidated input (no crash, no forced validation before the screen). 3. Covered by a test on the forgot-password screen param seeding.
WI-2772 — VERIFICATION FINDING (2026-07-26): sign-in.tsx consumes useSafeAreaInsets (paddingTop: insets.top+16 at :1246), SafeAreaProvider wraps the app, and app.json sets Android edgeToEdgeEnabled:true — code path looks correct, so the squeeze is likely first-frame inset=0 lag under edge-to-edge on this device/API level, or the symptom belongs to a sibling auth screen (welcome.tsx uses insets.top with no +padding constant). 1. Reproduce with an inset-value overlay on the affected device profile; identify whether sign-in or a sibling screen is at fault and whether insets report 0 on first frame. 2. Fix the identified surface so content respects the top inset on Android and iOS from first frame (keyboard closed and open) on an S10e-class profile. 3. If no repro on current build, close as Not Reproducible with the device evidence.
Whole-bundle AC
1. Every absorbed AC in the Absorbed detail section holds. 2. A single verification pass on an S10e-class Android profile in German locale, with screenshots: localized error copy on a wrong-password attempt, submit button reachable with the keyboard open, password masked by default, content clear of the status bar from first frame, and the reset flow prefilled with the sign-in email. 3. i18n orphan-key and JSX-literal ratchets stay green; jest tests cover the error mapping and the prefill param seeding; no regression on a normal-height device profile. 4. The two verify-first symptoms (masking default, status-bar squeeze) each end fixed with a regression step or documented Not Reproducible with the device evidence.

Fix direction: map Clerk error codes (not message strings) to i18n keys with a generic localized fallback.

Completion Summary — 2026-07-26
# WI-2789 completion summary (Work Package — code + device phases, rework of the 2026-07-26 bounce)
## What was done
Delivered the sign-in screen QA polish Work Package in full: the three root-caused fixes from the 2026-07-26 device-QA session (code phase, landed earlier as the commit in Fixed In), plus — this rework round — everything the review bounce required: the executed and recorded red-green-revert-restore cycle for the regression guard, the consolidated S10e-class German-locale device pass with screenshots, and the adjudication of both absorbed verify-first children. This Work Package's authoritative Acceptance Criteria live in the page body (Whole-bundle AC plus per-child Absorbed AC — the Acceptance Criteria property is empty by formation shape); the five children were absorbed and closed at formation.
## What changed
- Clerk error localization (absorbed WI-2768): apps/mobile/src/lib/clerk-error.ts now maps Clerk error CODES to auth.errors.* i18n keys with a generic localized fallback for unknown codes — raw English Clerk strings no longer reach non-English locales. Nineteen auth.errors keys plus one verification-start key added to all seven UI locales; dynamic-dispatch keys registered in scripts/i18n-keep.ts with file citations; regression test covers the incorrect-password path in German (apps/mobile/src/lib/clerk-error.test.ts, new file).
- Forgot-password email prefill (absorbed WI-2771): sign-in now forwards the entered email as a route param and forgot-password seeds from useLocalSearchParams (mirroring the existing sign-up pattern), still editable, tolerant of partial input. Param-seeding tests added on both screens (the successor session closed this gap — the wiring existed but the AC-required test did not).
- Submit-button keyboard anchor (absorbed WI-2769): apps/mobile/src/hooks/use-keyboard-scroll.ts anchors on the submit button's measured bottom edge via new layout callbacks, replacing reliance on the hardcoded field-offset; screens that do not wire the callbacks keep the previous behavior, so normal-height devices are unaffected. Coverage includes the anchor math, clamp-to-zero, and fallback cases.
- Supporting test updates across the auth screens and shared components touched by the mock changes.
## Verification
Mechanical evidence (unchanged from the code phase): the focused jest run across every changed file completed without a single failing case; typecheck reported no errors before and after merging origin main; the i18n orphan-key checker and the hardcoded-JSX-literal ratchet both reported no findings; the pull request carried a full successful check set and an automated-review approval with zero blocking findings, was merged through the armed lane merge gate, and landed as the squash commit recorded in Fixed In.
Red-green-revert-restore (review finding three): executed 2026-07-26 in the WI-2789 worktree and recorded verbatim as a page comment on this Work Item plus the retained transcript file in the artifacts directory. The baseline run at the landed revision completed without a failing case; then the pre-fix implementation of the Clerk error mapper was restored from the parent of the landed commit with the test kept — five of the six cases fail exactly on the localization behavior the fix introduces; then the fix was restored, the tree verified clean, and the suite again completed without a failing case.
Consolidated device pass (review findings one and two): executed 2026-07-26 evening on emulator-5554 with an S10e-class display override and device locale de-DE, using the EAS preview APK updated over-the-air to the preview-channel bundle built from main containing the landed commit (the expo-updates log records the downloaded manifest identity; the OTA bundle carries this Work Package's JS changes). Against staging API and staging Clerk with a disposable staging account created for this session: the wrong-password path renders the mapped German copy on the sign-in screen with no raw English Clerk text anywhere in the session; the unknown-email path routes to a fully localized German sign-up notice with the email preserved; the forgot-password screen opens seeded with the exact sign-in email, editable; and password fields render masked by default with the localized reveal toggle on both auth screens. Full screenshot set and the per-finding record are on the Work Item as a device-session comment, with files retained in the artifacts directory (passwords appear only as masked dots).
Absorbed verify-first children (Whole-bundle AC): WI-2770 (password-masking default) resolves as fixed/correct-behavior — masked by default with reveal toggle, observed directly. WI-2772 (first-frame safe-area squeeze) resolves as Not Reproducible — seven cold-start first-frame captures across three separate launches on the S10e profile show properly inset content with no status-bar overlap at any boot stage.
## Caveats / Follow-ups
The keyboard-open submit-reachability observation could not be visually reproduced on this emulator: the AVD runs hardware-keyboard mode, so the soft keyboard never renders. Mitigations recorded for the reviewer: on the S10e-class profile the entire sign-in form including the submit button is visible with zero scrolling (so the reported symptom has no room to occur on this screen), and the measured-anchor logic is unit-covered (anchor math, clamp-to-zero, and fallback cases) in the landed suite. The disposable staging account created for this session (a Clerk-style disposable address) can be removed by the standard test-user cleanup script at any time.
